summary: The correction is right and S2R-DRIFT-ROUNDING is closed. README.md:8 now gives the maximum S-anchor drift as 1.36%. I checked this against all twelve rate_ratio values in evidence.json. The largest deviation is 0.9863739663868872 at evidence.json:1154, and abs(rate_ratio-1) gives 1.3626%, which rounds to 1.36%. The 5% gate conclusion does not change. I found no other mention of 1.37% in the task directory except the archived round-01 review record. The rest of the report reads the same as the version that passed in round 1: provenance pins, the six-job table, the 72 cases (48/12/12), the performance table, walltime caps, disclosed limitations and the proposed-only 1/2/4-node Stage 3 matrix. The files added since the previous commit are the round-01 review records and the status metadata. status.json still says round_2_pending, with the finding listed as unresolved against the previous commit. That is expected for a review that has not yet been recorded, and it is not a defect in the report.
